support_review.reason: Not a forwarding-only wrapper: Assert.False(pending.IsCompleted) and AwaitingReply distinguish early handler entry from the configured HTTP+accounting operation reaching its actual await. Introduced specifically in 11b994c7 (#1591). KindFor, kind and epoch forwarding preserve production routing.

Dedicated LongRunning workers and task unwrapping preserve independent provider entry/completion threads and bounded deadlock diagnostics; replacing by inline forwarding or ordinary Task.Run would reintroduce 793efab0 (#2306) pool starvation and alter synchronous pause/admission ordering.

Failed-deadlock branch deliberately avoids another blocking gate or cancellation registration dispose; normal branch disposes world then handler and temp directory. Not interchangeable with ordinary using-only fixture.

Inline completion source, cancellation registration, early Started signal, AllowReturn gate, real body and request count are causal controls; existing immediate response HTTP handlers do not reproduce them.

One-line forwarding body duplicates other private provider-suite factories but no shared TestSupport IHttpClientFactory exists. Deleting it requires exposing/coupling another private suite or creating support; no clearly smaller current-lane edit identified. All copies preserve disposeHandler:false; do not replace with factory that owns/disposes held handler.
